newClaim.claimText: Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez established an official institutional Artificial Intelligence Policy (dated July 6, 2026) governing all students, faculty, researchers, staff, and leadership across all campuses, establishing a tri-part governance structure (Executive Committee, AI Hub, Advisory Committee), mandatory institutional tool vetting for sensitive data, continuous monitoring of agentic AI systems, and mandatory disclosure of AI tools in research publications.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Official Documents Learn about and download institutional policies, ethical use guides, and principles that guide the incorporation of AI at UAI. UAI Artificial Intelligence Policy Encourages, regulates, and guides its responsible use in teaching, research, and management. Learn more Responsible AI Use Guide for UAI Faculty Supports the pedagogical application of AI through a personalized design, based on UAI's unique characteristics and aligned with international best practices.
